user_problem: An instructor needs short items that distinguish named misconceptions from ordinary calculation mistakes.
unique_output: A diagnostic set pairing each item with targeted misconception, expected distractor reasoning, and interpretation limits.
required_input: Learning objective, explicitly named misconceptions, correct rule, response format, and desired item count.
critical_rule: Do not infer a learner belief from one response; label results as evidence to investigate, not diagnosis.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is classroom-quiz-builder; this targets discrimination among supplied misconceptions rather than producing a general quiz.
acceptance_scenario: Input objective compares fractions; misconception says larger denominator means larger value. Output includes choosing between 1/4 and 1/3, identifies 1/4 as the targeted distractor, and requires a second probe before interpretation.
